Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

shall also be informed by telephone / e-mail to submit the same to the Office of Additional-Director, CGHS. As per the existing guidelines, the medical claims of beneficiaries aged 80 years and above shall be processed on priority out of turn. - OM, dated 18-9-2019.
